paper_metadata.title: Microstructural characterization and mechanical behavior of Cr25Ni35NbM alloy dissimilar weld joint for application in a hydrogen reformer furnace

evidence.quote: The Cr25Ni35NbM heat-resistant alloy has excellent high temperature creep strength, good oxidation and carburization resistance and satisfactory ductility.
flanges of the reformer furnace are usually made of ferritic steels (CrMo Steel).
Currently, the material of pigtail pipe in the hydrogen reformer furnace is austenitic stainless steel [4,5].
The welding materials are 25.35.4.CNb wire which is made by Metrode Products Ltd UK.
The as-cast Cr25Ni35NbM alloy consists a g-solid solution matrix, eutectic carbides, niobium-based(NbC) and chromium-based carbides(M 7C3)
The metallographic microstructure of rolled 15CrMo steel consists of pearlite and ferrite (Fig. 2b).
The microstructure of SUS321 stainless steel is austenite with many twins.

Cr25Ni35NbM alloy tubes are made by centrifugal casting tube, while 15CrMo steel tube and SUS321 austenitic stainless steel tube are rolled tubes. The tubes diameter of test coupon is OD 108 mm with thickness 8 mm.

For Cr25Ni35NbM/15CrMo dissimilar weld joints, there are three weld layers, which the interpass temperature is about 100 K and the shielding gas is argon to prevent oxidation (Fig. 1). In order to prevent the welding hot cracking in the weld joint, the weld joint is preheated and post-weld heated. The preheating temperature is above 723 K, and the post-weld heat treatment is 923 K ± 10 K.
For Cr25Ni35NbM/15CrMo dissimilar weld joints, there are three weld layers, which the interpass temperature is about 100 K and the shielding gas is argon to prevent oxidation (Fig. 1).
There are also three weld layers in Cr25Ni35NbM/SUS321 dissimilar weld joint, and the interpass temperature is less than 150 K with the argon as shielding gas to prevent oxidation (Fig. 1).
